solution_summary: As a company providing solutions to the tourism and hospitality industry, Amadeus operates in 190 countries. Created in 1987 by four European airlines, Amadeus has expanded its reach beyond flight booking, into a diverse range of travel solutions. "One of the challenges for large-scale, global organizations is the collaboration and the data management. Amadeus provides a broad range of solutions for airlines, hotels, and travel agencies. The implementation centers on Copilot for Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft 365, Outlook to support enterprise knowledge search workflows. Amadeus being one of the first Copilot for Microsoft 365 customers, a first wave of 300 users scattered through the different business units and in different positions received a license in early August.

solution_components.name: Copilot for Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Provides the employee assistant used to summarize, draft, and retrieve information in day-to-day work.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Teams
solution_components.role: Acts as the collaboration surface for prompts, meetings, and shared knowledge.

solution_components.name: Microsoft 365
solution_components.role: Provides the productivity suite where the new workflows are delivered to employees.

solution_components.name: Outlook
solution_components.role: Provides the email workspace where AI-assisted drafting and summarization are used.
